skills.description: This skill should be used when the user provides a requirements design specification document (e.g., 概要设计说明书 / 需求设计说明书 / 详细设计说明书 in .docx format) and asks to generate a COSMIC function point measurement spreadsheet (.xlsx). It extracts functional requirements from the design document, decomposes them into functional processes and sub-processes, classifies data movements (Entry/Read/Write/eXit), and outputs a standard 12-column COSMIC function point table compliant with PBOSS project conventions and the COSMIC ISO 19761 methodology. Triggers include phrases like "生成 COSMIC 表格", "功能点度量", "生成功能点拆分表", "从概要设计生成 COSMIC", "COSMIC 度量", "function point estimation".
